storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dark place, away from heat and damp; whole pods keep their aroma far longer than powder.
looksLike: Small pale-green ribbed pods about 1 cm long, holding sticky black seeds with a sweet, floral aroma.
howToPick: General guidance, not from a source in this run: plump green pods of even size with a strong sweet smell. Avoid pale, shrivelled, dusty pods or ones that smell stale.
shelfLife: About 1 year whole in a sealed pack (general guidance).

usedIn.raw: 2 pods per serving (1 in the rice water, 1 in the masala)
